title: Fix long-book chapter navigation

commits.message: fix: make long-book chapter navigation usable

user_summary: 长篇小说左侧只见前十几章，章节目录无法搜索/跳转，缺少上一章下一章，无法快速到达数百章之后。
technical_summary: Wide-screen 章节目录 only focused left nav; sidebar overflow scrolled whole pane without independent chapter list viewport and rendered all chapters. Fix: ChapterListViewport 100-chapter windows + independent overflow-y; ChapterNavigatorDrawer with search/ordinal/ranges; ChapterAdjacentNav prev/next; applyNavigateToChapterReading clears analysisRun/tab/journeyView.
acceptance_criteria: Left chapter list independently scrolls with 100-chapter windows
Top 章节目录 always opens navigator drawer with search/ordinal/ranges
Prev/next and unified navigateToChapterReading without analysisRun/tab/journeyView
verification_evidence: Manual 1.0.4: book with 1299 chapters, /books/3?chapter=5&view=reading showed only first dozen chapters; no usable catalog search/jump; no prev/next.
Root: openCatalogOrFocusNav focused left list on wide screens; workspace-chapter-list had no independent scroll; full DOM render of all chapters.
Local vitest: chapterNavigation + ChapterNavigatorDrawer + BookWorkspacePage + BookRoutePage (43 passed); typecheck/lint/version/registry/diff-check green.
